name: Wikidata5M
description: Wikidata5M is a large-scale knowledge graph dataset with aligned entity descriptions designed for pre-training and evaluating knowledge embedding and language representation models. It serves as a benchmark for knowledge embedding methods, facilitating research on large knowledge graphs, inductive knowledge embedding, and knowledge graphs with textual information.
reputation: A well-known large-scale Wikidata benchmark for knowledge graph embedding and inductive link prediction, commonly used in KG representation learning research.
notes: Constructed to benchmark knowledge embedding methods with aligned textual entity descriptions; supports inductive knowledge embedding evaluation.
